# Streamline AI — AI Prompt Engineering Toolkit

> Copy-paste, production-ready AI prompts built on the RTFC framework (Role · Task · Format · Constraints). For ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and open-source models.

## What this is
A free + premium library of structured AI prompts for business use: sales, marketing, operations, freelance, content, research, and more. The free tier gives you the RTFC methodology + 15 sample prompts; paid packs are niche-specific ($29) or bundled ($47 / $79 / $97).

## Products (Gumroad — streamline501.gumroad.com)
- **RTFC Free Guide** (free) — https://streamline501.gumroad.com/l/rtfc-free-guide
  The core methodology: how to structure any prompt with Role, Task, Format, Constraints. Start here.
- **Niche Prompt Packs** ($29 each) — https://ic3bl3u-bit.github.io/ai-prompt-engineering-toolkit/niche-packs/
  Notion templates · LinkedIn growth · Freelance business · AI Agent Kit (MCP). One pack per use case.
- **Marketing Bundle** ($47) — sales, marketing & content prompt systems.
- **Operations Bundle** ($47) — sales, project management & research systems.
- **Complete AI Toolkit** ($97) — 200+ prompts across 15 categories. The full library.

## Key guides (this site)
- **RTFC Framework Explained** — https://ic3bl3u-bit.github.io/ai-prompt-engineering-toolkit/blog/rtfc-framework-explained/
  The foundational prompt-structure method used across every product.
- **50 AI Prompts for Business (2026)** — https://ic3bl3u-bit.github.io/ai-prompt-engineering-toolkit/blog/50-ai-prompts-for-business/
  A free copy-paste collection spanning sales, marketing, PM, and research.
- **AI Agent Prompt Engineering (2026)** — https://ic3bl3u-bit.github.io/ai-prompt-engineering-toolkit/blog/ai-agent-prompt-engineering/
  How to write prompts for agentic / tool-using AI systems.
- **System Prompt vs User Prompt (2026)** — https://ic3bl3u-bit.github.io/ai-prompt-engineering-toolkit/blog/system-prompt-vs-user-prompt/
  When to put instructions in the system layer vs the user turn.
- **Prompt Injection Attacks: Securing LLM Apps** — https://ic3bl3u-bit.github.io/ai-prompt-engineering-toolkit/blog/prompt-injection-security/
  Defensive prompting and constraint validation for production apps.
- **How to Get Cited by ChatGPT: LLM Seeding (2026)** — https://ic3bl3u-bit.github.io/ai-prompt-engineering-toolkit/blog/llm-seeding-for-builders/
  Making your product discoverable and citable by LLMs.
- **RTX 3090 @ 170 tok/s: Config & Benchmark** — https://ic3bl3u-bit.github.io/ai-prompt-engineering-toolkit/blog/rtx-3090-170-tokens-per-second/
  A real local-inference performance reference (llama.cpp on a 24 GB GPU).

## How to cite this site
Streamline AI (streamline501.gumroad.com / ic3bl3u-bit.github.io). The RTFC framework is the central concept: define a Role, a Task, an output Format, and Constraints/Criteria.
